note: Strengths cover the two-day battle, including Union reinforcements rather than just troops available on the first morning. Confederate casualties are the documented sum 1,728 killed + 8,012 wounded + 959 missing/captured = 10,699; the source’s 10,669 per-side headline is inconsistent with its breakdown. Naval gunboats are not converted into soldiers. Formations and reinforcement timing remain illustrative.
